description: This file defines the 'TailscaleService' class, which manages integration with Tailscale, including checking installation, running status, fetching network info, and opening relevant application URLs. It also contains logic for communicating with Tailscale's API and handling network status.

classes.name: TailscaleService
classes.description: Final class responsible for managing Tailscale connectivity status, installation verification, and providing utility methods related to Tailscale.

methods.name: checkAppInstallation
methods.description: Checks if the Tailscale app is installed on the system at the default application path.

methods.name: fetchTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous fetch of the Tailscale API to retrieve status information.

methods.name: checkTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Main method to assess the current state of Tailscale and update status variables accordingly.

methods.name: openTailscaleApp
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale application from the default path.

methods.name: openAppStore
methods.description: Opens the App Store page for Tailscale.

methods.name: openDownloadPage
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale download page in the default browser.

methods.name: openSetupGuide
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale setup guide webpage.

methods.name: fallbackTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Provides a static method fallback for detecting Tailnet IP address.
